Krampus Kristmas starts now!

Robert Zilbauer·November 17, 2026
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:46
Instaread

The world’s first 24/7 Krampus radio station! Free & live through Christmas Eve. Hosted by Krampus himself!

Been feeling like you needed more naughty in your noel? Want to push back against all that sappy Christmas music that’s already starting to show up in grocery stores and elevators? Now you can!

The folks over at Stupid Potato have all of your Krampus needs covered.

What’s that mean, exactly? It means:

  • 200+ Krampus songs: heavy metal, black metal, industrial, punk, yodel, polka, rockabilly, surf rock and gothic carols
  • The Krampus Tales: 30 fireside Christmas stories, introduced by Krampus
  • One-minute Krampus facts: his name, the chains, the birch switches, the masks and the Krampus runs
  • Krampus’s Kousins: talks on Belsnickel, Frau Perchta, Grýla and the Yule Lads, the Yule Cat, the Mari Lwyd and more
  • The Naughty List Network: Krampus Express, Krampus-Proof Stockings, Krampus Krunch and the rest of the sponsor’s family
  • Vintage Christmas commercials from the 1950s to the 80s

But wait! There’s more!

The Official Krampus Kristmas Radio Station page also has:

  • Ten Krampus cartoons!
  • A short history of Krampus!
  • Krampus traditions!
  • Krampus FAQ!
  • Krampus postcards!
  • Info on the world’s other Christmas monsters!

And last, but certainly not least… Krampusnacht.

“Krampus Night” is coming! Saturday, December 5th (6 PM to midnight Central; 7 PM to 1 AM Eastern; 4 to 10 PM Pacific).

What is Krampus Night, you ask?

The night before Saint Nicholas Day, when Krampus walks. Six hours of Krampus Night on this stream: the darkest Krampus songs, Krampus Tales and talks on his cousins, with Krampus at the microphone.

Sounds like a good time. Pretty sure the Scariest Crue will be there.

Will you?

Article by Robert Zilbauer.
